mapper.sql: SELECT r.*,a.asset_code,a.asset_name,u.nick_name reporter_name,p.nick_name repairer_name FROM ca_repair r JOIN ca_asset a ON a.asset_id=r.asset_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=r.reporter_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user p ON p.user_id=r.repairer_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT r.*,u.nick_name operator_name FROM ca_repair_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=r.operator_user_id WHERE r.repair_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.action_time,r.record_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=#{id} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.role_id JOIN sys_menu m ON m.menu_id=rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' AND m.status='0' AND m.perms='campus:repair:execute')
